strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s); 道彦 = 0719 #15 Dylan (US contact Bug Catcher Doug)

strings.zh: 想要和虫精灵{NEWLINE}搞好关系的话,{CLEAR}就和我交换下电话号码吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If you want to get along with Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, trade phone numbers with me!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好,谢谢！{NEWLINE}我也会给你打电话的！
strings.en: You betcha. Thanks!{NEWLINE}I’ll call you sometime!

strings.zh: 你终于想来和我{NEWLINE}交换电话号码了？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh, did you decide to exchange{NEWLINE}phone numbers after all? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哦,你来了啊！{SCROLL}我一直都等着{NEWLINE}想给你果实呢！{SCROLL}请收下吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, there you are!{SCROLL}I thought I’d give you a Berry, so I’ve{NEWLINE}been waiting here for you!{SCROLL}Here you go!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？{SCROLL}如果你就在附近的话,{NEWLINE}那就别打电话,{CLEAR}直接来找我吧！
strings.en: Wait, what?{SCROLL}If you’re nearby, don’t bother with the{NEWLINE}phone. Come talk in person!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}现在成长得{CLEAR}非常好了！{SCROLL}最近我还瞬间就{SCROLL}放倒了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}瞬间哦！{SCROLL}我很厉害吧？
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} is growing up well,{NEWLINE}if I do say so myself!{SCROLL}Why, in a recent battle against{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}, it knocked it out before{CLEAR}I could blink!{SCROLL}Before I could even blink! Amazing, eh?

strings.zh: 真受不了！{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}都已经那么强了,{SCROLL}还以为能轻松打倒{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}之类的,{SCROLL}但仔细一看,{NEWLINE}发现对方级别好高啊⋯⋯{CLEAR}我被打得落花流水。
strings.en: Argh, I give up! My {VAR:0100:10} has{NEWLINE}gotten pretty strong, you know.{SCROLL}I figured that it should be able to{NEWLINE}easily knock out a {VAR:0100:11}...{SCROLL}But once we got a good look at it, we{NEWLINE}saw it was really high level...{CLEAR}We got beaten up, down, and sideways...

strings.zh: 话说,前段时间我在路上的时候{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}突然{CLEAR}从路边跳了出来！{SCROLL}不管我再怎么喜欢精灵,{NEWLINE}这么跳出来也吓死我了。{SCROLL}能不能在跳出来之前{NEWLINE}报上自己姓名啊。
strings.en: You know, earlier by the roadside, this{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} jumped out at me!{SCROLL}I really love Pokémon, but...bam!{NEWLINE}It sure startled me!{SCROLL}I mean, if you’re going to jump out at a{NEWLINE}person, you should at least have the{CLEAR}decency to introduce yourself first!

strings.zh: 我想是时候该让你{NEWLINE}见识见识虫精灵的魅力了！{SCROLL}你有空吗？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}过来和我对战吧。
strings.en: I think it’s time I showed you just{NEWLINE}how great Bug-type Pokémon are!{SCROLL}Are you free? I’m at{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}.{CLEAR}Come over and battle me.

strings.zh: 来和我进行一场久违的对战吧！{NEWLINE}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}别忘了过来！
strings.en: Let’s have a battle. We haven’t had one{NEWLINE}in a while! I’m on {VAR:0104:3}...{CLEAR}Don’t forget!

strings.zh: 我的爸爸是{NEWLINE}虫精灵领域的研究人员。{SCROLL}所以我很小的时候开始{NEWLINE}家里就全部都是虫精灵。{SCROLL}正因为如此{NEWLINE}我也喜欢上了虫精灵。{SCROLL}可我妈⋯⋯{NEWLINE}天天都能听到她的尖叫。
strings.en: You know, my dad is a researcher in the{NEWLINE}field of Bug-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}So ever since I was little, our house{NEWLINE}has been full of Bug-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}That’s why I came to love Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, too. But my mom...{SCROLL}I hear her screaming every single day.
strings.notes: US 0692/12 | RV072: omission: daily screaming; dad still a researcher

strings.zh: 我找到果实了,{NEWLINE}我已经有很多了,{CLEAR}所以给你吧！{SCROLL}我人在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}快来拿吧！
strings.en: I found some Berries. I’ve already got{NEWLINE}more than I need, so I’ll give you some!{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}. Come pick{NEWLINE}them up!

strings.zh: 你不会不想要果实了吧？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你来拿！
strings.en: You want Berries, don’t you?{SCROLL}I’ll give you some if you come visit me{NEWLINE}on {VAR:0104:3}!
